def: The ranking shown during a competition, computed on a public part of the hidden test set.
The final competition ranking, computed on the part of the test set that stays hidden until the end.
A large change in participants' ranks between the public and private leaderboards.
The tendency of the best score among many candidates measured on the same data to overstate how good the best candidate really is.
A prediction formed by combining the outputs of several models.
Combining models by averaging the ranks of their scores, which puts different scales on a common footing and suits rank metrics such as AUC.
Combining model predictions with weights chosen on held-out or out-of-fold predictions.
Training a meta-model on the out-of-fold predictions of base models so that it learns how to combine them.
The second-level model in a stack, whose inputs are the predictions of the base models.
Predictions for each training row made by a model that was trained without that row's fold.
The degree to which models make different mistakes, which decides how much averaging them helps.
